citations.F1: N+1 query on users table — serialize_event does conn.fetchrow() per event (1,912 calls for acme); batch-fetch actors with WHERE id IN (...)
citations.F2: Dedup inefficiency — O(n²) list lookups on `if ev["dedupe_key"] in seen`; use set instead.
citations.F4: Missing index on (org_id, created_at) — event query scans full table; CREATE INDEX events_org_id_created_at_idx ON events(org_id, created_at DESC).
citations.F5: Unbounded _request_timings list — module-level list appends every request forever, contributing to memory leak; cap at last 10000 entries
citations.F6: Unbounded _geo_cache per worker — module-level dict grows without eviction ... switch to functools.lru_cache(maxsize=10000).
citations.F7: re-measure with Datadog (expect p95 to drop from 11.2s to <2s for acme)
